835669e6.task:
Perform COMPLETE reconnaissance and attack-surface mapping of https://zyro-ai.in (this is the only in-scope target; do NOT test other domains).

Deliverables:
1. Subdomain enumeration (subfinder, crt.sh-style passive sources) for zyro-ai.in — note any live subdomains found via httpx probing.
2. Port scan of the main host(s) with nmap/naabu (bounded: top ports, reasonable timeout).
3. Technology fingerprinting: web server, framework (this looks like it may be a Zyro/AI site builder site or a custom app), response headers, TLS cert details (SANs!), WAF detection (wafw00f).
4. Full crawl of the web app: use katana (bounded depth ~3, JS crawling enabled) and/or gospider. Extract ALL endpoints, forms, input parameters, API paths, hidden routes.
5. JS file analysis: download JS bundles, look for API endpoints, secrets, tokens, environment configs (JS-Snooper or manual grep).
6. Identify authentication surfaces: login/signup/password-reset forms, session mechanisms, JWT usage, cookies (flags, SameSite).
7. Directory/file discovery with ffuf/dirsearch using a common wordlist (bounded) — look for admin panels, /api, debug endpoints, .git, .env, backups, config files.
8. Quick nuclei run with exposure/misconfig/exposed-panels/technologies templates only (bounded, no intrusive exploitation).

Write your consolidated findings to /workspace/recon_report.md with sections: Subdomains, Ports/Services, Tech Stack, Endpoints & Parameters (full list), Auth Surfaces, Interesting Findings (secrets, exposed files, unusual endpoints), Recommended Test Targets ranked by risk. Also save the raw endpoint list to /workspace/endpoints.txt.

Keep crawls/scans bounded (depth/time) and clean up oversized raw output files when done — /workspace is shared. Do NOT perform active exploitation or injection attacks — recon/mapping only.
